summary.text: Adam Burkhammer is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 64, where he has served since 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a business owner and former associate pastor.

paragraphs.text: Adam Burkhammer graduated from Buckhannon-Upshur High School and earned a degree from West Virginia Christian University in 2011.
His career experience includes working as an associate pastor with Cornerstone Community Church and as a business owner.
Burkhammer has served in the House of Delegates since 2020 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
